root: ^Drent: Name’s Drent. I see you’ve taken care of those thieves, eh?
^ About time someone chased that lot out of my home. It’s been unbearable down here — all their blasted love ballads about their leader ringing through the tunnels.
^ At last, I can rest easy, with nothing but the gentle flow of water to lull me to sleep.

c-0: ^Drent: Does that trouble you? Hah. Life seldom deals a fair hand. This place, for all its… peculiar charms,
^ still beats the stench of politics and pretension you lot endure up above.
^Drent: Down here, I’ve got peace, quiet, and a steady temperature. No landlord breathing down my neck, no nosy neighbors,
^ and certainly no tax collectors. The occasional rat? Far better company than most people I’ve met.
^Drent: Now then, if you’re done gawking at my choice of residence, perhaps we can talk about something that actually matters?
